summary: Phase D — Safeguards & disagreement pathway fully validated. Ran 17/17 unit tests (test_sn_pathway.py) plus 15/15 new e2e tests hitting live API (test_sn_pathway_e2e.py) covering schema, bulk-save, /scores.pathway, tier mapping (T1-T4 across all 6 scenarios), determinism, safeguards math, /mediation/reports/sections/sn_report, PATCH visibility, /report/generate persistence, and PDF size diff with ?excluded=safeguards_pathway. Frontend verified live: /neurodivergent Q39 renders 'Safeguards already in place' with 4-choice buttons (In place/Partial/Not yet/Not needed), click persists via bulk-save. /neurodivergent/reports renders Section 6 pathway card (nd-sec-safeguards-pathway) with tier T3 label + summary, 3-column safeguards snapshot, disagreement chips including 'Risky response pattern', 5 action cards. Selective sharing panel shows 7/7 sections with new 'Safeguards & disagreement pathway' toggle between structure and Parenting-plan worksheet (Part 7).
critical_code_review_comments: sn_pathway.py compute_disagreement caps disagrees at +6 correctly; but DOMAIN_ITEMS scan and CONSISTENCY_ITEMS scan double-add to disagree_ids before cap — consistent with tests (cap applied via min(6,len)) so behaviour is fine.
sn_report_pdf.py still uses deprecated fpdf2 `ln=1` parameter (DeprecationWarning). Low priority — cosmetic.
Frontend /neurodivergent has 52 questions in a one-at-a-time flow with no jump navigation; not a defect for this phase but a UX consideration for parents mid-way.
seed_data_creation: Live e2e tests seed neutral safeguards + specific scenario answers for parent1@test.com via /api/neurodivergent/answers/bulk (no cleanup — safe since answers are per-user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase D functionality verified. /api/neurodivergent/schema exposes safeguards section (13 items, 3 groups, 4-value scale). /api/neurodivergent/scores returns pathway block with tier/safeguards/disagreement/actions. Tier mapping deterministic and matches spec: T1=defaults, T2=3+ missing, T3=idx≥5 OR (idx≥3 & risky), T4=idx≥8 OR (idx≥5 & missing in 2 groups). Safeguards math: mean of in_place(100)/partial(55)/not_yet(0); not_needed excluded. Disagreement: +1/disagree(cap +6) +2 risky +2 critical-low, max 10. PDF with ?excluded=safeguards_pathway is smaller than default. Frontend NeurodivergentReports renders all pathway testids correctly. Regression: no impact on existing 6 SN sections or coordination scoring.
